chunks: And with this chain of transmission, from al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd, from Faḍālah, from Ḥammād ibn ʿUthmān, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a man who does not find water: should he perform tayammum for every salat (prayer)? He said: No, it is in the position of water.

key_terms.بِمَنْزِلَةِ: having the legal standing or status of
key_terms.يَتَيَمَّمُ: he performs tayammum, the dry ablution in place of wudu (ablution) or ghusl

ai.seo_question: Does a person without water need to perform tayammum again for every salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith states that a person who cannot find water does not need to renew tayammum for every salat (prayer). The Imam عليه السلام rules that tayammum holds the status of water in this context, indicating its continuing validity for multiple prayers.
